description: Defines an immutable Note class representing a note entity with various properties and a copyWith method for object cloning with modifications.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: An immutable data class representing a note with properties like localId, remoteId, title, body, tags, updatedAt, isDeleted, and dirty. It includes a copyWith method for creating modified copies.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Note instance with specified fields replaced by new values, enabling immutable updates.
